title: Dossier completeness: an honest inventory of coverage
headline_insight: 1,249 player dossiers span 28 analytic categories, but the median dossier is only 46.4% complete.
what_it_means: The player-intelligence layer holds 1,249 dossiers across 28 categories, and coverage is deliberately uneven. Rebounding profile fills 95.4% of dossiers while pace fit fills just 1.0%, so the depth a given player gets depends heavily on which questions the underlying data can answer.
how_to_read: category_fill_rate is the share of dossiers that have each category populated; the categories-filled distribution shows how many of the 28 categories each individual dossier reaches.
why_it_matters: It is an honest inventory of what the intelligence actually covers versus what is still sparse, with no pretense that every player is fully profiled.
caveat: Completeness measures field population, not correctness; a filled category is not a claim that the metric inside it has been validated.
